// taipei-trip.typ — 台北之旅 · June 2–8, 2026
// Compiles with Typst 0.14

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// chip helper: simple box-based label+value chip

  box(
    radius: 5pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 2pt),
    fill: accent.lighten(88%),
  )[#text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label] #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]]
}

// color strip
#let strip(color) = {
  box(width: 100%, height: 5pt, radius: 2.5pt, fill: color)
}

// rating badge
#let rating-badge(label) = {
  box(radius: 4pt, inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt), fill: C-gold)[
    #text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: C-navy)[#label]

  margin: (top: 1.4cm, bottom: 1.4cm, x: 1.8cm),

#set text(

#show par: set block(spacing: 6pt)
#show strong: set text(weight: 700)

  #v(18pt)
  #line(length: 100%, thickness: 0.5pt, color: C-muted.lighten(50%))
  #v(14pt)

  #text(size: 12pt, weight: 700, color: C-navy)[實用資訊]

    text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[June 平均氣溫 26–33°C，午後偶有雷陣雨],
